Read the realized bounds from fidelity_report(); frequency sensitivity depends on the mode and the affected dimension. REMEDY: choose dx commensurate with the patterned dimensions, slide the lattice origin onto the worst face, or (non-uniform lane) place mesh nodes on the design edges.
